page.overview:
What is Chen Village?

Chen Village is built along the sand dunes on the edge of Heaven-Reaching River. Each house has a wooden fence and bamboo yard. Red smartweed and yellow rush leaves grow along the banks, which are also the nesting grounds of various birds.
